meeting_summary.going: Straight: yielding; round: good-yielding in places

races.name: Irish Stallion Farms European Breeders Fund Bold Lad Sprint Handicap (Premier Handicap)
races.verdict:
A fiercely competitive sprint, but KEKE goes well here and remains on a fair mark with a good-value claimer booked so could be worth chancing. The unexposed Bear on The Run is a big danger, with Staysound Susie and Dmaniac also of firm interest, particularly if the rain arrives.

  1. KEKE
  2. BEAR ON THE RUN (IRE)
  3. STAYSOUND SUSIE (IRE)

races.name: Tattersalls Ireland Super Auction Sales Stakes
races.verdict:
A wide-margin winner on her second start, STAR OF STATE was edged out only late on upped in grade for the Lowther at York and she looks to hold leading claims of doubling her tally. The biggest threat could come from Atlantic Bridge, who has been going the right way in his 3 starts, ahead of Treasurer.

  1. STAR OF STATE (IRE)
  2. ATLANTIC BRIDGE (IRE)
  3. TREASURER (IRE)

races.name: Moyglare Stud Stakes (Fillies' Group 1)
races.verdict:
SUN GODDESS is proving to be one of the leading 2-y-os of the season so she's hard to oppose with this extra 1f sure to suit. Green Empress can follow the selection home once again.

  1. SUN GODDESS (IRE)
  2. GREEN EMPRESS (IRE)
  3. ALPHA (IRE)

races.name: BAR 1 Betting Flying Five Stakes (Group 1)
races.verdict:
COMANCHE BRAVE took his form to a new level when gaining his Group 1 breakthrough in the July Cup at Newmarket and the way in which he went about that strongly suggests the drop to 5f won't be an inconvenience. He looks the answer, with Nunthorpe second and fourth Starlust and Time For Sandals (second choice) heading the opposition.

  1. COMANCHE BRAVE (IRE)
  2. TIME FOR SANDALS (IRE)
  3. STARLUST

races.name: Goffs Vincent O'Brien National Stakes (Group 1)
races.verdict:
A short-head winning margin did no justice whatsoever to MONOGRAM in a C&D maiden last month and appealing as the type to improve markedly (possesses loads of physical scope), Joseph O'Brien's well-bred colt can take this significant step up in class in his stride. Giant Sequoia was by no means all out when landing the Futurity Stakes, so he can provide most resistance, with the unbeaten English-raider Dr Rascal rounding off the shortlist.

  1. MONOGRAM
  2. GIANT SEQUOIA (USA)
  3. DR RASCAL

races.name: Comer Group International Irish St. Leger (Group 1)
races.verdict:
High-class stayer SCANDINAVIA has strong claims to make it 8 wins on the bounce. Jan Brueghel should relish the step back up in distance and could make it a 1-2 for Aidan O'Brien, while Trustyourinstinct isn't one to underestimate following his stylish win in the Curragh Cup last time.

  1. SCANDINAVIA (USA)
  2. JAN BRUEGHEL (IRE)
  3. TRUSTYOURINSTINCT (IRE)

races.name: Moyglare ''Jewels'' Blandford Stakes (Fillies' & Mares' Group 2)
races.verdict:
THUNDERING ON was a most impressive winner of the Oaks earlier in the season and is fancied to get back on track following a blip in the Pretty Polly here last time. Timeforshowcasing, Red Letter and Lilt appeal as the likely dangers.

  1. THUNDERING ON
  2. TIMEFORSHOWCASING
  3. RED LETTER

races.name: Irish Stallion Farms European Breeders Fund Northfields Handicap (Premier Handicap)
races.verdict:
A competitive handicap can go the way of sole British raider HIGH DEGREE given he has held his form really well this season. Amadeus Mozart and Alphonsus Liguori are a pair of interesting 3-y-os who can make their presence felt, with Fixation another to consider.

  1. HIGH DEGREE
  2. AMADEUS MOZART (IRE)
  3. ALPHONSUS LIGUORI

races.name: Royal Bath & West Society Apprentice Handicap
races.verdict:
KEV showed a good attitude when getting off the mark in classified company at Lingfield 17 days ago on just second start for current connections and can follow up back in a handicap. Rogers Dream is clearly improved, having switched to front-running tactics to devastating effect when routing rivals by 7½ lengths at Ripon 13 days ago and is feared most. Shifra goes well at this trip and holds place claims, too.

  1. KEV
  2. ROGERS DREAM
  3. SHIFRA (IRE)

races.name: Loud Hire Nursery
races.verdict:
Q T BOY shaped well on his nursery debut at Chepstow 15 days ago, seeing out the trip despite the soft ground, and he is taken to go one better now upped to 1m. Magical Life opened her account over this trip at Kempton in August and rates the chief threat, while Thunda Struck showed more under patient tactics on nursery debut and can figure if her stamina holds.

  1. Q T BOY
  2. MAGICAL LIFE
  3. THUNDA STRUCK (IRE)

races.name: Loud Hire Staging Hire Bath Summer Stayers' Series Final Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
BOILERMAKER has shown improved form upped to this trip, making it back-to-back wins when scoring under a positive ride at Wolverhampton last time, and the 3-y-o is taken to score again with more still to offer as a stayer. Next best could be the consistent Lusaka, ahead of Belle of Kt.

  1. BOILERMAKER (FR)
  2. LUSAKA (IRE)
  3. BELLE OF KT

races.name: Loud Hire Production Services Bath Summer Sprint Series Final Handicap
races.verdict:
A fiendishly competitive sprint which can go the way of MORTUBO, who holds a class edge over most of these and the form of her Newmarket second back in June has worked out very well (had 3 next-time-out winners behind her). Big Time Rascal has made a cracking start for new connections so he's put forward as the main threat, with Geeman, Legendsoftheland and Neptune Legend just a trio of others worth considering, too.

  1. MORTUBO (IRE)
  2. BIG TIME RASCAL
  3. GEEMANN

races.name: Loud Hire Equipment Rental Restricted Maiden Fillies' Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
BIG HITTER has been found another good opportunity and ought to be getting off the mark in a first-time tongue strap. On The Queue Tee, Romidijo and Crimson Blaze can fight it out for the places.

  1. BIG HITTER (IRE)
  2. ON THE QUEUE TEE
  3. ROMIDIJO

races.name: Loud Hire Sound And Lighting Hire Handicap
races.verdict:
A chance is taken on SPIRITED DANCER who has gone close on several occasions already this year and has made an interesting stable switch. Last-time-out winner Recon Mission should be thereabouts again, while Jackie Brown is another to consider despite a wide draw.

  1. SPIRITED DANCER
  2. RECON MISSION (IRE)
  3. JACKIE BROWN (IRE)

races.name: Loud Hire Supporting Bath Racecourse Handicap (Div 1)
races.verdict:
TONAL thrived on the all-weather last winter and his Ffos Las success in June showed he's well treated from his lower turf mark. Up 5 lb but looks capable of defying it if returning from a break in top form. Blue Hero has 11 course wins here and went agonisingly close over C&D 11 days ago so looks sure to go well, while Decalogue improved further at Salisbury recently and wears first-time cheekpieces, which could help here.

  1. TONAL (FR)
  2. BLUE HERO (CAN)
  3. DECALOGUE (USA)

races.name: Loud Hire Supporting Bath Racecourse Handicap (Div 2)
races.verdict:
EUTROPIA is taken to land a third victory at this course. Fellow Bath specialist Albus Anne heads the dangers, along with relatively unexposed 3-y-o Mr Tony.

  1. EUTROPIA
  2. ALBUS ANNE
  3. MR TONY (IRE)

races.name: Land Of Lights Festival At Gullivers Handicap
races.verdict:
ADRESTIA was mixing it in much better company this time last season and following signs of a revival at Goodwood in late-July, she could well capitalise on a drop in grade. Unexposed 3-y-o sprinter Hypnotised is feared most, with Canon's House, Maelstrom, Jer Batt and The Man other likely players in a wide-open sprint handicap.

  1. ADRESTIA
  2. HYPNOTISED
  3. CANON'S HOUSE

races.name: Betfred 'The Classic Bookmaker' Handicap
races.verdict:
ASUKA gave a good account upped in grade for his hat-trick bid when third at Chester last time and, with this drop back in trip promising to suit, he is taken to resume winning ways. Completely Random is much respected, though, having made the frame at Royal Ascot and Glorious Goodwood, with Blue Brother also one to note.

  1. ASUKA
  2. COMPLETELY RANDOM
  3. BLUE BROTHER (FR)

races.name: Betfred City Of Doncaster Handicap
races.verdict:
WECHAAD opened his account in a C&D nursery at this meeting last season and having shaped well in just a handful of top-end handicaps this season, Roger Varian's colt earns the vote to double his tally with this return to 7f promising to suit. Heading up the dangers is Samra Green, who upped her game on return/handicap debut when runner-up at Musselburgh back in the spring, with Langstone and Raging Raj another couple worth considering, too.

  1. WECHAAD (IRE)
  2. SAMRA GREEN (IRE)
  3. LANGSTONE

races.name: Japan Racing Association Sceptre Fillies' Stakes (Fillies' & Mares Group 3)
races.verdict:
A big field but FORTY YEARS ON and Touleen stand out, the former narrowly preferred given her rate of progress. Copacabana Sands makes some each-way appeal on only her third start for Andrew Balding, while Darnation is an interesting contender back with Karl Burke.

  1. FORTY YEARS ON (IRE)
  2. TOULEEN
  3. COPACABANA SANDS (IRE)

races.name: Betfred Mallard Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
A tricky puzzle given the lack of obvious pace. There's no doubting that SAY WHAT YOU SEE arrives in the form of his life, though, and he gets the vote stepping up in trip. The main danger could be Valedictory, who finished ahead of a couple of today's rivals in a better race at York last time.

  1. SAY WHAT YOU SEE (IRE)
  2. VALEDICTORY
  3. DANCING IN PARIS (FR)

races.name: I Love Julie Parkes Handicap (Div 1)
races.verdict:
TIVA represents an in-form yard and arrives on the back of several solid efforts, including a recent Musselburgh win. The booking of a useful 5 lb claimer is an added bonus and she is taken to notch a fifth career success. Call Margot took a step back in the right direction and rates the main threat if building on that, while Hiya Maite is on a long losing run but well treated on the pick of his form.

  1. TIVA (IRE)
  2. CALL MARGOT (IRE)
  3. HIYA MAITE

races.name: I Love Julie Parkes Handicap (Div 2)
races.verdict:
MAHARAJAS EXPRESS has done nothing wrong in defeat on his last 2 outings and can gain reward with a second success of the season. The consistent Rock of England should be on the premises once more, with Smart Vision and Mighty Magnus also worth considering.

  1. MAHARAJAS EXPRESS
  2. ROCK OF ENGLAND (IRE)
  3. SMART VISION

races.name: Duncan Pearce Memorial Apprentice Handicap
races.verdict:
MIRACULOUS is still well treated after a good run of form and can resume winning ways in this very competitive affair at the expense of Dandy Magic, who looks sure to be suited by how this unfolds, while Sixtygeesbaby is a previous C&D winner who has the ability to be a real threat if putting his best foot forward.

  1. MIRACULOUS (IRE)
  2. DANDY MAGIC (IRE)
  3. SIXTYGEESBABY (IRE)

races.name: Hollywoodbets Scottsville Welcomes You Maiden Plate
races.verdict:
CLEAN SWEEP jumps off the page as the obvious winner. Barry's Boy could be the answer to second spot, while Mekong has a place chance as well.

  1. CLEAN SWEEP (SAF)
  2. BARRY'S BOY (SAF)
  3. MEKONG (SAF)

races.name: In The Box Seat Podcast Brought To You By Gallop TV D Stakes
races.verdict:
TIGER CODY can win again. Clickbait is likely to be waiting in the wings if the selection fails to deliver, while Champagne Mac can scrap it out for third.

  1. TIGER CODY (SAF)
  2. CLICKBAIT (SAF)
  3. CHAMPAGNE MAC (SAF)

races.name: Join The Passion! www.racecoast.co.za Maiden Plate (F & M)
races.verdict:
THAT'S A GIMME could be the way to go. Pink Skies is a player, while Glitter Paint has place prospects as well.

  1. THAT'S A GIMME (SAF)
  2. PINK SKIES (SAF)
  3. GLITTER PAINT (SAF)

races.name: Lucky Fish Plinko Maiden Plate
races.verdict:
LE CONCIERGE took a huge step back in the right direction on his latest start and is well up to winning this. Owner Of Creation appeals most among the rest, although Maggiano also requires consideration.

  1. LE CONCIERGE (SAF)
  2. OWNER OF CREATION (SAF)
  3. MAGGIANO (SAF)

races.name: Tote For The Win B Stakes
races.verdict:
NORDIC CHIEF could be the way to go. Bangladesh is a solid alternative, while Tam's Knight also needs a closer look.

  1. NORDIC CHIEF (SAF)
  2. BANGLADESH (SAF)
  3. TAM'S KNIGHT (SAF)

races.name: Bet With Colossus Pools Exclusive On www.tote.co.za C Stakes
races.verdict:
STRONGER TOGETHER has an excellent chance. One Armed Bandit is the pick for second, while Arverni Princess is another with the potential to be on the premises.

  1. STRONGER TOGETHER (SAF)
  2. ONE ARMED BANDIT (SAF)
  3. ARVERNI PRINCESS (SAF)

races.name: Gallop TV Progress Plate
races.verdict:
ASCALON DANCER gets the vote in this tight contest. Sweet Green is second choice, while Erik Dubois is one to bear in mind as well.

  1. ASCALON DANCER (SAF)
  2. SWEET GREEN (SAF)
  3. ERIK DUBOIS (SAF)

races.name: Hollywoodbets Bright Future Class 4 (F & M)
races.verdict:
WHAT A CLASSIC looks set to win again. Anushka poses the biggest threat, while Lady Godiva is the third candidate for the three.

  1. WHAT A CLASSIC (SAF)
  2. ANUSHKA (SAF)
  3. LADY GODIVA (SAF)
